title: A lane that changes the mutation harness may run the mutation job before its batch, as a named exception to lanes-run-no-full-ci-job.
ruling: Owner page answer to item 463 (mutate-harness-lane-run), 2026-11-09 13:09 CST, pick a: ruling lanes-run-no-full-ci-job gains one exception: a harness change's own suite is the mutation job. PR 2733 quotes it as "for a lane that changes the mutation harness, its own suite is the mutation job, run before the batch" (the decision's paraphrase). Not ruled: up to three runs per touched lane, a 75 min cap and 225 min worst case, asked of the coordinator.
